div.head: Wl art 8a
div.ab: et si quisquam talium evaserit, videant plegii ut simpliciter solvant quod calumniatum est, et purgent se, quia in evaso nullam fraudem noverunt.

And if any such escapes, the members of the frankpledge shall be responsible for the simple payment of what is claimed, and shall clear themselves from [the charge of] any knowledge of fraud on the part of the runaway.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 240–241 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
